name: Boundless Love
description: When he was a little child, Halil İbrahim lost his father due to a blood feud and was exiled to Istanbul. Twenty years later, he returns to his homeland in the Karadeniz region as a handsome, powerful young man. He plans to marry the girl he loves, Yasemin, and start a new life. However, events do not allow this. Halil İbrahim embarks on a journey of revenge, and his life will change completely when he encounters Zeynep from the Leto family.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim, who lost his father as a young boy due to a blood feud and was exiled to Istanbul, returns 20 years later to his hometown in Karadeniz as a handsome, strong young man. He will marry Yasemin, the girl he loves, and build his new life. But events do not allow this. Halil İbrahim embarks on a journey of revenge, and his life will change completely with the appearance of Zeynep from Letos.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Having lost Yasemin, the only thing that keeps Halil İbrahim alive is the fire of revenge. Halil İbrahim's only target is the Letos, but the Letos will take Tarık's death out on everyone, guilty or innocent. Zeynep, whose good intentions cause even more deaths, tries to save herself from the cruelty of her family.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Confronting Zeynep, Halil İbrahim, with her help, plans to turn Letos and the gendarmerie against each other and turn the war against him into a three-sided one. Even though the Letos seem to have left Halil İbrahim behind because of their own troubles, First Lieutenant Oğuz is on Halil İbrahim's neck. Zeynep, who believes that she can get rid of Levent thanks to Halil İbrahim's plan, is not yet aware that she has dug a deeper hole for herself.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim learns from First Lieutenant Oğuz who told Tarık Leto their location. When her father still forces her to marry despite all Levent's cruelty towards her, Zeynep looks to her brother for help. When Fikret can't do anything, Zeynep asks Halil İbrahim to kidnap her on the day of her wedding. In return, Halil will bring Cevat, his father's murderer, to avenge Ibrahim. Will Halil İbrahim be able to take his revenge and save Zeynep?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim's kidnapping of Zeynep from her wedding causes polarization among the Letos. Fikret and Nedime, who want Zeynep to return home safely, try to convince Rızvan to extend a hand of peace to Halil İbrahim. Asiye is determined to get rid of Halil İbrahim, even at the cost of Zeynep's life. In this war, will the first to reach Halil İbrahim and Zeynep be a friend or an enemy?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: When Zeynep threatens to expose her father for all her family's dirty deeds, Halil İbrahim and his friends are freed. However, Levent and his family will not accept this defeat immediately; they demand Halil İbrahim's head in exchange for Zeynep's safety. Will Fikret be able to protect his sister's life or her heart?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: For Zeynep's sake, Halil İbrahim and Fikret decide to settle their feud through talking instead of bloodshed. Halil İbrahim, who will sit at the table of wolves, will face Leto and Kulpas with a big trump card with the help of the people who are sympathetic to his cause. Asiye, who cannot trust the men in the family to get things done, takes the reins. Pushing Edanur to divorce Temel and trying to separate Leyla from her beloved for good finally brings Asiye face-to-face with Zeynep.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim, who is sure that Zeynep is innocent, wants to kidnap Zeynep and save her, but Zeynep's freedom is between Asiye's lips. Will Nedime, who even agrees to go to Asiye's feet for Zeynep, be able to give up her daughter even if she gives up her pride? Will Halil İbrahim and Zeynep give up on each other if they accept Asiye's condition?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Zeynep's decision to stay and marry Halil İbrahim rather than leave the country shakes both Halil İbrahim's family and Zeynep's family. Asiye uses Zeynep's elopement to Halil İbrahim as an excuse to speed up Leyla's engagement. This time, Halil İbrahim will break off the engagement not with a gun but as a member of the family. Nedime calls her nephew Yılmaz, whom everyone is afraid of, to remind everyone who is behind her children. Only time will tell who will be his friend and who will be his enemy.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: When Yilmaz's real business is revealed, everyone chooses sides. Fikret withdraws from the business because he will never break his rules. But both Fikret and Zeynep will be pawns in the trap set by Rızvan and the other families to get rid of Halil İbrahim for good. Halil İbrahim, who learns that a trap will be set against him, makes dangerous plans to get rid of all his enemies. Who will be hunted while on the hunt?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim's last show of power causes great shock among his enemies. While Yılmaz targets Halil İbrahim's innocents and loved ones, the decision Rizvan will make will shake the dynamics of the entire family.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim and Rızvan unite against Yılmaz under the leadership of Fikret. Asiye, who cannot tolerate the fact that Zeynep and Nedime won, does not accept this peace and makes a deal with Yılmaz. Asiye and Yılmaz duo will not let anyone down, especially Halil İbrahim and Zeynep.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: When Halil İbrahim is kidnapped, Zeynep wants to make peace with Asiye in order to save his life, but she faces that her own family will not make the sacrifices she made for Halil İbrahim. Fikret, who does not bow to Yılmaz, establishes new partnerships to chart his own path. Will Halil İbrahim, Yılmaz's captive, manage to survive until he is rescued from captivity?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Yilmaz's actions against Halil Ibrahim cause everyone to face their own fate. Zeynep, who is the most happy that Halil İbrahim is saved, has a fiery reunion with him. But when Yilmaz's father gets wind of what happened, he puts his team to work to pull the plug on Oğuz, Fikret, and Rızvan along with Halil İbrahim. When all the families come together for a good deed, who will survive?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Many people, including Rızvan, are hit in the clash during the wedding. When everyone pulls a gun on each other, old distrust resurfaces and agreements and alliances are broken, and relatives become enemies again. Will Halil İbrahim and Zeynep's love be enough to overcome their resentment towards each other, or will they be on opposite sides after this breaking point?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The hostility between Halil Ibrahim and Fikret escalates. A big confrontation begins between Nedime and Asiye, who are under the same roof to be with Rizvan. Zeynep, who does not want to be in the middle of all her loved ones, can only distance herself from conflicts. Will she lose her husband or brother due to hostilities that she could not prevent? Or will Halil Ibrahim and Fikret find a middle ground?

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Although the waters between Halil İbrahim and Fikret have calmed down for now, the Letos will not rest easy. Taking advantage of the return of Tuncay, the younger son of the Letos, Yılmaz has nefarious plans to avenge Rızvan's death. As Zeynep remembers that she is a Karasu again, she faces two dangers at once. Will Zeynep be able to embrace Sevda and Ceylan, whom Halil İbrahim has taken in? What kind of danger awaits Halil İbrahim and Zeynep?

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim, who has managed to survive thanks to Zeynep, comes to the deal table again with the Fikrets, but they have a common enemy to get rid of first: Yilmaz Marten. Halil İbrahim embarks on a dangerous game to get rid of Yilmaz for good, while Zeynep enters the den of wolves without knowing what is going on in her father's house. Surrounded by enemies, will Halil İbrahim and Zeynep be able to save themselves?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim and Zeynep find themselves trapped in very different situations, separated from each other. While it's unclear if they have escaped from the troubles caused by Yılmaz, the return of Rızvan reveals a secret alliance. Halil İbrahim, unaware of a new danger looming, prioritizes getting back his estranged wife. However, Rızvan is not the only one involved in covert activities. Halil İbrahim also has a big surprise in store for his enemies.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The fact that Fikret, Yavuz, and Levent are still on Halil Ibrahim's side starts a civil war between fathers and sons. It's not for nothing that they say you can't even trust your father in this day and age... When it comes to family, all hands are dealt with, and the only thing left to do is redistribute the cards. Enemies become friends, and friends become enemies. As Halil Ibrahim continues to move forward on the path he believes to be right, the bullet comes painfully from a place he never expected.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim, who is under close surveillance after Oğuz's lieutenant is wounded, has attracted the attention of both his enemies and the state. As the state escalates, an uninvited guest comes to take a hand in Halil İbrahim's case. Halil İbrahim, who is always one step ahead of his enemies, could not foresee what a jealous woman would do. No matter what, when it comes to Zeynep, everything stops. Has Halil İbrahim reached the end of the road this time? Is everything permissible for love?

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Halil Ibrahim admits that for the first time in his life, he is faced with something he is afraid of losing. Even though Zeynep is reunited with Halil Ibrahim, she does not remain silent any longer in the face of those who covet what is hers. Fathers eventually manage to spoil their sons' tastes with the help of mothers. Even the most indestructible alliances will crack at some point. Fikret, who holds his head high despite all of Rizvan's threats, makes a move that no one expected. It leaves the ambitions of those who think they have won in a rut. As they say, he who goes hunting gets hunted. Halil Ibrahim has a secret weapon that he is hiding from everyone.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Even though Halil İbrahim cannot get exactly the punishment he wants, everyone gets what they deserve. There is no calm among women either. Although Zeynep was kicked out of both her father's and her husband's house, she is tested by the women who do not leave. While the fathers are being imprisoned one by one, they are now thought to be harmless and everyone feels relieved. Halil İbrahim is aware that a storm will break out after this silence. Feeling uneasy after what she heard, Zeynep goes to Halil İbrahim. Halil does not realize that he is putting himself in danger while helping İbrahim to save his loved ones. So who will the bomb explode on?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim manages to save everyone before the explosion occurs. As the tension between Zeynep and Ceylan continues, it will be of great importance whose side Halil İbrahim will take. While the fathers regain their freedom, the imprisoned person becomes someone else. Yılmaz has no intention of going in. How he finds the way out will create confusion and the arrows will return to Halil İbrahim. The first one to find Yılmaz will win. So, will Halil İbrahim be able to act before everyone else and finally take his revenge?

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Yilmaz meets his end with someone unexpected. This ending enrages a father that no one would want to confront, and everyone's fears come true. Nihat, Yilmaz's father, finally returns to the square he left empty for revenge. Halil Ibrahim continues to stand tall no matter what. Zeynep does not hesitate to threaten even her father because she has a husband like Halil Ibrahim behind her. Even though Asiye and Rizvan do not take Zeynep seriously, Halil Ibrahim proves on a quiet night that Zeynep's threats are not empty. While everyone is focused on the enemy in front of their eyes, no one notices the real snake silently approaching. This time, the danger is very close, even within them.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: While everyone is trying to get their son off the hook, Nihat has already made up his mind. He proves what a ruthless man he is when he explains his decision to the fathers. A father can be angry and punish his son, but can he kill him? Halil İbrahim makes a plan for Nihat to be hunted on the way to the hunt. But an unforeseen person turns all plans upside down. Will he be the hunted one this time? Zeynep, while sleeping in her most innocent state, cannot smell the approaching danger. Now, the end of the road has come.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: They say the best weapon against one enemy is another enemy. Things change when fathers receive orders to kill their sons. With Nihat's play, everyone's true colors are revealed once again. Unfortunately, Fikret is not as lucky as the others. While the men are willing to put even trade aside, there is something they cannot take into account. Jealousy is the most dangerous emotion for a woman especially when it's based on a long history. This time, the blood is spilled at the women's table, not the men's.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Asiye Leto's sudden death shocks everyone. The gendarmerie arrives at the door and detains Ceylan while Halil İbrahim tries to figure out why the incident happened. When Ceylan says that Zeynep is the one who instigated him, the situation gets complicated. Halil İbrahim tries to get Zeynep out of prison after she is arrested, but Zeynep is skewered in the ward. Will Zeynep live? How will Halil İbrahim avenge Zeynep?

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Zeynep is attacked in prison and is immediately hospitalized. Halil İbrahim takes action to hold those who did this to Zeynep to account. Hearing what happened to his daughter, Rızvan Leto is desperately upset. Halil İbrahim attacks Nihat's place with his team and catches Hakan. Will he kill Hakan to avenge Zeynep? Will Zeynep, who is in bad condition, survive?

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Tamer, who is encouraged by Nihat to kill Fikret, accidentally shoots and kills Tuncay Leto. While the Letos mourn the death of their little son, they try to find out who did this. Zeynep, who learns that she will not have children anymore, tells Halil İbrahim that the relationship is over. Even though Halil İbrahim suffers, he has to continue his fight. Nihat, who does not stop to take further revenge, will kill Levent again by using Tamer. Will Tamer be exposed? How will Halil İbrahim take his revenge on Nihat?

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Everyone is stunned by Levent's death. Tamer, who is obsessed with his lust for power, is not aware that he is Nihat's hitman. Halil İbrahim thinks that Zeynep has given up on him and buries his love in his heart. While he struggles with Zeynep's love, he makes plans for Nihat. Tamer's new target is Fikret. Will Tamer be able to kill Fikret?

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Tuncay and Levent's revenge has been taken. Fikret is emotionally affected by this situation of the Letos. Halil İbrahim tries to make things right between them out of his love for Zeynep. But Zeynep blames herself for not having a child with Halil İbrahim. Halil İbrahim visits Nedime and asks her for Zeynep again. Will Zeynep Halil return to İbrahim?

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Zeynep is determined not to return to Halil İbrahim. Although Halil İbrahim tries to persuade Zeynep, Zeynep says that she does not want him anymore. Halil İbrahim confronts his pain and decides to continue on his way without Zeynep. Zeynep sees Halil İbrahim, who went to dinner with Didem, at the restaurant. Making plan after plan, Nihat gets Halil İbrahim with an agreement.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Nihat takes Halil İbrahim and tortures him to make him suffer. Undaunted, Halil İbrahim escapes from Nihat's hands. Zeynep and Halil İbrahim, who went to court for divorce, are still in love with each other.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Halil Ibrahim is distraught over Zeynep's plans to marry Iskender's son. Tensions rise as families clash. Fikret tries to change Zeynep's mind. Iskender has secret plans that could lead to disaster for all involved.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: The slap by Zeynep impacts multiple lives. Halil Ibrahim must choose between Zeynep and Didem. Zeynep tries to protect her family. Iskender's secret plans lead to a confrontation with Halil Ibrahim. Events spiral as consequences unfold.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Fikret's return from death disrupts the balance in the family once again. While Zeynep has an emotional showdown with Halil Ibrahim, Iskender's secret moves continue to pose a threat. As Didem poses an increasingly greater challenge to Zeynep, Halil Ibrahim comes to the brink of a difficult decision.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: While Fikret faces serious accusations regarding Dursun's unexpected death, tensions rise between Zeynep and Halil Ibrahim. Didem and Kaan make a secret collaboration to separate Zeynep and Halil Ibrahim from each other. Meanwhile, Iskender continues to track down his missing money and prepares for a big move.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: When Dervis returns from the dead, Halil Ibrahim burns with a thirst for revenge, and the family relationships are turned upside down. While Zeynep stands by Halil Ibrahim to support him, Kaan's unexpected steps fuel the tension even more. While Didem is waiting for an opportunity to push Zeynep away, Iskender puts his plans into action step by step.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim takes Zeynep from İskender's house, once again upsetting all the balances. As İskender and Kaan's anger grows, Didem and Kaan's collaboration brings Zeynep and Halil İbrahim's bond to the breaking point. Derviş's unexpected move further escalates the tension in the family.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Halil Ibrahim takes off the ring on Zeynep's finger and replaces it with his own ring, declaring their love once again. This big step makes conflict inevitable with Kaan and Iskender's anger. Didem has a hard time with the pain of separation from Halil Ibrahim. While the tension between the families increases, Iskender puts his new plans into action. Will Zeynep and Halil Ibrahim be able to defend their love against everyone? What kind of disaster will Iskender's dangerous plans trigger?

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Didem's pregnancy deeply shakes Zeynep and Halil İbrahim's relationship. While Zeynep has to confront Didem, Halil İbrahim takes action to resolve this crisis. However, İskender's secret plans and Kaan's dangerous moves are about to lead everyone to a disaster.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim, upon his discharge from the hospital, takes action to settle scores from the past. Zeynep stands out with her bold decisions while struggling under the pressure from İskender and Kaan. As tensions between the families escalate, Halil İbrahim's surprise plan is set to change everyone's fate.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim takes action to turn the weakness of his enemies into an opportunity following the arrest of İskender and Şeref. While Zeynep faces dangers at İskender's house, Kaan's threatening behavior increases the tension. Enver's confessions at the police station bring the families to the brink of new chaos, and Halil İbrahim's next move will determine everyone's fate.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: As Nesim's tragic death disrupts all balances, Halil İbrahim and Fikret take action for revenge. While Zeynep has a dangerous meeting with Halil İbrahim, the risky situation concerning Didem's baby drags the family into an even more challenging process. Meanwhile, the moves of İskender and Kaan ignite the fuse of a new conflict.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Halil rescues Zeynep from Iskender's trapped house. Tensions rise due to Seref and Iskender's actions. Didem's pregnancy impacts family dynamics. Kaan and Gamze's choices shape events.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The terrible accident involving Halil İbrahim and Zeynep disrupts the balance between the families. İskender tries to change the course of events to protect his son. However, Halil İbrahim is determined to investigate the background of the incident. The unexpected moves by İskender and Kaan make the situation unmanageable for Halil İbrahim. The decisions Halil İbrahim will make will not only determine the outcome of the conflict but will also change everyone's lives.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim faces a new crisis when Zeynep goes to İskender's house. While Zeynep confronts Kaan in the shadow of the past, İskender's plans shake the families even more deeply. Didem takes an unexpected step against Zeynep and upsets the balance again. In the meantime, Halil İbrahim is forced to make a big decision to protect his family.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim sends a strong message to his enemies by attacking İskender's house. However, this move triggers new confrontations between the Letos and Kemal. As Esma is dragged into a dangerous path by her father's surprise decision, Zeynep and Fikret try to resolve the tensions within the family. Halil İbrahim takes action to break the circle of betrayal surrounding him.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: As Fikret and Halil İbrahim prepare to change the balance with an unexpected collaboration, Zeynep faces a difficult decision regarding her family. While Didem takes action to prevent Esma from getting close to Halil İbrahim, Ferhat's dangerous move opens the door to a major disaster.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: The revelation of the game Zeynep set up turns the balance upside down. While Ferhat's unexpected move opens the door to a new negotiation, Cengiz's threats towards Mithat further escalate the conflict within the family. As Mithat, with his decision, steps on the path to marriage with Ayşe, this situation becomes a new challenge for Fikret and Halil İbrahim. Meanwhile, Didem's schemes corner Zeynep, and with the support of Nedime and Damla, Zeynep confronts Halil İbrahim.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Mithat's murder on the wedding night shocks everyone, while Halil İbrahim goes after the killer, and Fikret and Zeynep try to uncover the truth. As Nergiz makes a dangerous move to protect her family, Kaan takes action for revenge. What Didem tells Kemal about Esma and Halil İbrahim shakes Zeynep, and Ayşe's move for revenge leads to a great disaster.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Fikret is taken to the hospital, Halil İbrahim stands by Zeynep during this difficult wait. While Halil İbrahim and Zeynep do their best to keep the events secret, Ayşe decides to go to the police station to confess her crime. While Zeynep tries to prevent Ayşe from confessing, everything quickly becomes complicated. While Kemal makes critical decisions to ensure the safety of his family, Zeynep and Halil İbrahim enter a struggle they have never encountered before, under the shadow of dangers. While Zeynep goes through a great test with the effects of what happened and the new risks she will take, they enter a difficult period together with Halil İbrahim.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Halil İbrahim and Esma come to the brink of a new war after the attack in which they came face to face with death. While Kemal takes action with the great secret he learned, an unexpected collaboration is born between Esma and Zeynep. On the other hand, Didem and Kaan's move corners Halil İbrahim, while Fikret and Zeynep have to make difficult decisions to protect their family. The big iftar dinner where all the accounts will be settled becomes the beginning of a new conflict.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: While Halil İbrahim and Zeynep try to stay on their feet in the midst of major conflicts, the bloody attack in front of the courthouse changes all balances. While Fikret's confession leaves Esma face to face with a difficult choice, Kemal's anger opens the door to a new war.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: When Halil İbrahim kills Kaan, all balances are disrupted. While Didem's threat drags Halil İbrahim and his family into a great impasse, Zeynep makes a decision that will surprise everyone to save the man she loves. On the other hand, while Fikret and Esma try to build a new life, Kemal's anger leads to an irreversible conflict.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: After suffering great losses, Halil İbrahim and Zeynep are forced to confront their pain and anger, while the decisions Fikret makes open the door to a new war. Esma is shaken by Fikret’s withdrawal, and Didem’s move puts Halil İbrahim in front of a difficult choice. Meanwhile, a surprise move by İskender shifts all the dynamics, prompting Zeynep to take a critical step to protect her family. As Fikret’s patience runs out, Halil İbrahim springs into action to stop him.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Fikret shooting İdris turns everything upside down, and Halil İbrahim takes a major risk to hide him. While Zeynep struggles with the difficult situation her brother is in, Didem’s pursuit of the truth becomes a new threat for Halil İbrahim. Meanwhile, on Kemal’s side, the plan against Fikret becomes increasingly clear, leaving Esma and Zeynep caught between conflicting decisions. Mecnun’s intervention signals a development that could shift all the balances.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Didem's pressure drags Halil İbrahim and Zeynep's lives to an irreversible point. While Halil İbrahim agrees to a marriage he does not want in order to protect his loved ones, Zeynep is prepared to pay the heaviest price for this sacrifice. On the other hand, while Kemal's execution ignites the fuse of a new war, the cooperation that begins on the Iskender and Fikret front changes all the balances. Russo's arrival is the harbinger of a great conflict.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: With Russo's arrival, Halil İbrahim and Fikret find themselves in the middle of a new danger. While İskender's decision changes the direction of the war, the bond between Halil İbrahim and Zeynep becomes even stronger.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Zeynep's unexpected step changes all the balances between Halil İbrahim and Didem. While a new era begins for Halil İbrahim, Zeynep's decision drags Didem to a path of no return. On the other hand, Russo opens the door to a great disaster with the new attack he will launch. While the decisions made on the İskender and Kemal fronts change the direction of the war, Fikret and Esma try to get rid of the shadow of the past. However, the biggest storm is yet to break out. How will Zeynep's move affect Didem? Who is Russo's new target?

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: With Russo kidnapping İskender, Halil İbrahim and Fikret find themselves caught in the middle of a high-stakes negotiation. Despite everything they’ve endured, Zeynep and Halil İbrahim take a hopeful step toward building a future together—but behind their happiness, a looming storm brews. Meanwhile, Esma’s decisions spark new fractures within the family, and Russo’s launch of a large-scale shipment operation signals the onset of an impending war.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Rizvan is murdered, shocking the family. Zeynep encounters Halil Ibrahim, resurfacing emotions. Didem's closeness to Halil Ibrahim emotionally impacts Zeynep. Halil Ibrahim avoids Zeynep, but their past lingers.
